description: This Python source file defines a CredentialService class responsible for managing encrypted credential data. It provides methods to create, retrieve, list, update, and delete credentials, utilizing encryption functions and a repository pattern for database interactions.

classes.name: CredentialService
classes.description: Service for encrypted credential storage, providing methods to handle credential operations with encryption and database access.

methods.name: Credential create(self, owner_id: int, title: str, plain_text: str)

methods.name: str get_plain(self, cred_id: int, owner_id: int)

methods.name: List[Credential] list_for_owner(self, owner_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all credentials associated with a specific owner.

methods.name: Credential update(self, cred_id: int, owner_id: int, new_plain_text: str)
methods.description: Updates the content of an existing credential by encrypting new plaintext.

methods.name: None delete(self, cred_id: int, owner_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a credential based on ID and owner ID.
